control.description-key: OpenTavu AI capture panel for meetings (Module 3, Part B, Activity Capture).

property.name: aiSummary
property.description-key: Concise meeting summary written by the AI.

property.name: discoveryExtract
property.description-key: Discovery insights extracted from this session.

property.name: aiConfidence
property.description-key: AI confidence as a whole percentage (0-100). Bind to the Decimal column.

property.name: confidenceThreshold
property.description-key: Below this value the meeting is flagged for review. Default 70.
